fields.Name: T139 - Integrations Overview
fields.Description: Verifies the Integrations app Overview view renders its KPI/activity widgets or a valid empty-state without crashing.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the Integrations application. To reach it, open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and SCROLL the full list (it is long) to find 'Integrations'; if it is not in the switcher, try the application cards on the Home page, or the 'Configure Apps' option to add/open it. In Integrations, view the Overview and verify it renders with KPI cards/activity (or a valid empty-state), no crash. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Integrations app is active and the Overview section is displayed
The Overview shows KPI cards and/or an activity feed, or a clean empty-state placeholder
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
